chats.answer:
If you're deciding between a fitness tracker and a smartwatch, the best choice depends on whether you primarily want to track your health and workouts or also use phone-like features on your wrist.

Fitness tracker vs. smartwatch
Shop

Fitness tracker

Examples: Fitbit Charge, Garmin vívosmart

Smaller and lighter

Typically longer battery life

Focused on steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts

Usually less expensive

Shop

Smartwatch

Examples: Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch

Larger, more interactive screen

Calls, messages, apps, payments

Fitness and health tracking

Typically shorter battery life

My recommendation: Choose a fitness tracker if exercise, sleep, and health metrics are your priorities. Choose a smartwatch if you also want notifications, apps, and everyday convenience.

For example, the Fitbit Charge 6 is rated for up to 7 days of battery life, compared with up to 24 hours for the Apple Watch Series 11.
